title: Digital Systems 2
objectives: The main objective of Digital Systems 2 is to cover fundamental theoretical principles and practical applications.
syllabus:
Computer Arithmetic | Instruction Set Architecture (ISA) | MIPS Single-Cycle/Multi-Cycle
Implementation | Performance Evaluation | MIPS Pipeline Implementation | Memory
Hierarchy (including Cache, Main Memory and Secondary Storage) | Input / Output System |
Multicore Processors Architecture
textbooks:
D. A. Patterson, and J. L. Hennessy, “Computer Organization and Design: The
Hardware/Software Interface”, 4th Edition, Morgan Kaufmann Publishers, 2014
